item.title: Making Torah Your Own: A New Journal of Women’s Insights

item.title: Keren Hachomesh Thanks 1,630 Donors to Campaign
item.description: Keren Hachomesh, the Charitable Foundation established by the Rebbe in honor of Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka, extends heartfelt thanks to the 1,630+ donors who answered the call and contributed to this special fund--the Rebbe’s tribute to the Rebbetzin. Full Story

item.title: New York Governor Hochul Visits 770 Ramming Site
